name: Chianti Rùfina
terms: A longer-aged wine. Each DOC or DOCG's own rules decide whether it has a Riserva and how long it must age. Chianti Riserva needs at least two years, counted from 1 January after the harvest.

blurb.text: A subzone of the Chianti DOCG, in the hills north-east of Florence. Its wine is labelled Chianti Rùfina.

sources.name: Chianti DOCG production rules (disciplinare), as amended by Reg. (EU) 2024/2741, art. 5.6: Riserva needs at least 2 years from 1 January after the harvest
